english.title: Operator of aircraft cause / permit person to fly in aircraft as flight crew without required records
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of an aircraft registered in the United Kingdom which was

(A)_[flying on a public transport flight,]_
(B)_[operated by the holder of a national air operator's certificate,]_
(C)_[a helicopter flying on a commercial air transport operation,]_
(D)_[an aeroplane with a flight crew of one pilot flying for the purpose of commercial air transport,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY AIRCRAFT..), caused or permitted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to fly in the aircraft as a member of its flight crew when you did not possess an accurate and up-to-date record for that person and for the 28 days immediately preceding the flight showing all flight times, duty periods and rest periods and brief details of the nature of the functions performed in the course of those flight times.
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 175(3) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
